newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar closes firmer on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar closes firmer on fund buying.

text.p: White sugar futures firmed in late Wednesday trading as stop-loss fund buying pushed the March contract up to finish above $307, traders said.
"It's quite busy ahead of the close. We're seeing stop-loss buying by the funds," one said.
The March contract closed at $307.50, up $2.70, while May was at $306.80, up $2.40.
March dominated the total volume, which was at 1,746 lots.
Earlier in the day, profit-takers had capped March's gains at around $305.00 and caused the nearby white premium to narrow amid light trading.

Significant physical news was thin on the ground, although Russia's foreign trade ministry rejected market talk of bilateral negotiations with Cuba to buy 500,000 tonnes of sugar for second-quarter delivery.
Paris futures followed roughly the same course as London. March was up 50 cents at $307.00, while May was up 30 cents at $304.50.
